lint: clippy::await_holding_invalid_type; original clippy.toml disallows tokio::sync::MutexGuard across await
lock_identity: Both barriers clone the same LocalProcess inner Arc and lock its unchanged tokio::sync::Mutex<HashMap<ProcessId, ProcessEntry>>. No replacement lock or guard wrapper is introduced.
synchronous_owner: A spawn_blocking closure acquires blocking_lock; ready is sent only while this original guard is held, with cloned Arc custody and accepted_stdin_write_ids taken from the same original ProcessEntry.
release_order: The holder does not await. It waits in oneshot blocking_recv, explicitly drops processes only after release or sender drop. The async test sends release then joins the holder at the original unlock point.
failure_cleanup: If ready receiver disappears, send fails and the closure returns, dropping the original guard.
If the acquire future or test is cancelled or panics, release sender is dropped; blocking_recv returns Err and the original guard is released by explicit drop or unwinding.
The worker JoinHandle is awaited on the normal release path; cancellation cleanup does not depend on aborting a blocking task.
poison_semantics: Original and repaired map are the same Tokio mutex, with no std mutex poison handling to replace; the actual Tokio guard remains owned by one synchronous worker.
blocked_input_test_order: Original full input channel is filled.
Original exec_write is polled Pending before acquiring the barrier.
Ready confirms original map guard is held before exit=47 or unknown outcome is triggered.
Original custody outcome observation, exit-task abort and join, response checks, queue no-resend and accepted-write-id absence assertions all run before barrier release.
Only after barrier send+join does original shutdown run.
retained_exit_test_order: pipe_stdin setup occurs in its own short map-lock scope before the barrier; the fixture exit sender remains unsent and streams have no data.
Barrier is held before already-accepted ID is remembered and before process.exit(47).
Original outcome observation, publisher cancellation+join and custody exit-code assertion occur with the original map still locked.
Only after release+holder join do original read/new-write/idempotent-retry/custody-reservation assertions run.

handler_success_debug_evidence.behavior: Both original errors and all message/session assertions remain unchanged. Success now produces Result::expect_err panic including Debug output.

independent_review.setup_gap_review: No exit result or closed exit channel can occur before ready: TestProcess still owns unsent exit_tx; fixture stream senders remain open and no data is sent.
